get.description:
List all threat awareness contacts for a tenant.
RBAC: [Admin]

# Errors

Returns an error in the following cases:
- `Unauthorized` (401) - Missing or invalid authentication token
- `Forbidden` (403) - User does not have the required `Admin` role for the tenant
- `NotFound` (404) - The specified tenant does not exist
- `ServerError` (500) - Failed to list contacts due to an internal error

put.description:
Full replacement of threat awareness contacts for a tenant.
This will update existing contacts, create new ones, and delete existing
ones that are not provided in the request.

RBAC: [Admin]

# Errors

Returns an error in the following cases:
- `BadRequest` (400) - The request body is invalid
- `Unauthorized` (401) - Missing or invalid authentication token
- `Forbidden` (403) - User does not have the required `Admin` role for the tenant
- `NotFound` (404) - The specified tenant does not exist
- `Conflict` (409) - A contact with the same primary email/primary phone already exists or when trying to add too many contacts for the contact type
- `ServerError` (500) - Failed to create the contact due to an internal error

post.description:
Sends one test email with each threat awareness contact being specified in the `to` field of the email.

RBAC: [Admin]

# Errors

Returns an error in the following cases:
- `Unauthorized` (401) - Missing or invalid authentication token
- `Forbidden` (403) - User does not have the required `Admin` role for the tenant
- `NotFound` (404) - The specified tenant does not exist
- `ServerError` (500) - Failed to create the contact due to an internal error
- `Conflict` (409) - Must add contacts with a primary email before sending a test email
post.summary: Send Test Email to Threat Awareness Contacts
